# Black-Scholes

``` {r}
# European Call Option
bs_european_call <- function(S, K, r, sigma, T, q = 0) {
  d1 <- (log(S / K) + (r - q + sigma^2 / 2) * T) / (sigma * sqrt(T))
  d2 <- d1 - sigma * sqrt(T)
  
  price <- S * exp(-q * T) * pnorm(d1) - K * exp(-r * T) * pnorm(d2)
  price <- ifelse(T <= 0, pmax(S - K, 0), price)
  return(price)
}

# European Put Option  
bs_european_put <- function(S, K, r, sigma, T, q = 0) {
  d1 <- (log(S / K) + (r - q + sigma^2 / 2) * T) / (sigma * sqrt(T))
  d2 <- d1 - sigma * sqrt(T)
  
  price <- K * exp(-r * T) * pnorm(-d2) - S * exp(-q * T) * pnorm(-d1)
  price <- ifelse(T <= 0, pmax(K - S, 0), price)
  return(price)
}
```

``` {r s_star}
# Calculate critical commodity price

s_star_finder <- function(S, K, r, sigma, T, q = 0) {
  b <- r - q
  N <- 2*b/(sigma^2)
  M <- 2*r/(sigma^2)
  K_other <- 1 - exp(-r * T)
  q_2 <- (-(N - 1) + sqrt((N - 1)^2 + 4 * M / K_other))/2

  RHS <- function(S_i) {
    d_one <- (log(S_i/K) + (b + (sigma^2) / 2) * T)/(sigma * sqrt(T))
    return(bs_european_call(S_i, K, r, sigma, T, q) + (1 - (exp((b-r)*T) * pnorm(d_one))) * S_i / q_2)
  }

  b_i <- function(S_i) { # Slope of RHS
    d_one <- (log(S_i/K) + (b + (sigma^2) / 2) * T)/(sigma * sqrt(T))
    val <- exp((b-r)*T) * pnorm(d_one) * (1 - 1/q_2) + (1 - (exp((b-r)*T) * dnorm(d_one))/(sigma * sqrt(T))) / q_2
    return(val)
  }

  enhance_guess <- function(S_i) {
    cur_bi <- b_i(S_i)
    #print(cur_bi)
    return((K + RHS(S_i) - cur_bi * S_i)/(1 - cur_bi))
  }
  # Get initial guess
  S_inf <- K / (1 - 2 / (- (N - 1) + sqrt((N - 1)^2 + 4*M)))
  #print(paste("S_inf: ", S_inf))
  h_2 <- -(b*T + 2*sigma*sqrt(T))*(K / (S_inf - K))
  #print(paste("h_2: ", h_2))
  S_i <- K + (S_inf - K) * (1 - exp(h_2))
  #print(paste("S_i: ", S_i))

  guess_limit <- 1000

  # Whilst LHS and RHS are not equal...
  while(abs(S_i - K - RHS(S_i)) / K >= 0.000000001) {
    #print(S_i - K - RHS(S_i))
    # ...enhance guess
    S_i <- enhance_guess(S_i)

    guess_limit <- guess_limit - 1

    if(guess_limit <= 0) {
      #print("Exhausted guesses.")
      return(S_i)
    }
  }

  return(S_i)
}
```

``` {r bs_american_call}
bs_american_call <- function(S, K, r, sigma, T, q) {
  if (T <= 0) {
    return(max(S - K, 0))
  }
  if (q <= 0) {
    return(bs_european_call(S, K, r, sigma, T, q))
  }
  
  S_star <- s_star_finder(S, K, r, sigma, T, q)

  if(S >= S_star) {
    return(S - K)
  }

  b <- r - q
  N <- 2*b/(sigma^2)
  M <- 2*r/(sigma^2)
  K_other <- 1 - exp(-r * T)
  q_2 <- (-(N - 1) + sqrt((N - 1)^2 + 4 * M / K_other))/2

  d_one_star <- (log(S_star/K) + (b + (sigma^2) / 2) * T)/(sigma * sqrt(T))

  A_2 <- (S_star / q_2)* (1 - exp((b - r)*T) * pnorm(d_one_star))

  return(bs_european_call(S, K, r, sigma, T, q) + A_2 * (S / S_star) ^ q_2)
}
```

``` {r s_star_star_init_val}
s_star_star_init_value <- function(S, K, r, sigma, T, q = 0) {
  b <- r - q
  N <- 2 * b / (sigma^2)
  M <- 2 * r / (sigma^2)
  K_other <- 1 - exp(-r * T)
  S_ss_inf <- K / (1 - 2 / (-(N - 1) - sqrt((N - 1)^2 + 4 * M)))
  h_1 <- (b * T - 2 * sigma * sqrt(T)) * (K / (K - S_ss_inf))
  S_ss <- S_ss_inf + (K - S_ss_inf) * exp(h_1)
  return(S_ss)
}
```

``` {r s_star_star}
s_star_star_finder <- function(S, K, r, sigma, T, q = 0) {
  b <- r - q
  N <- 2 * b / (sigma^2)
  M <- 2 * r / (sigma^2)
  K_other <- 1 - exp(-r * T)
  q_1 <- (-(N - 1) - sqrt((N - 1)^2 + 4 * M / K_other)) / 2

  RHS <- function(S_j, K, r, sigma, T, q = 0) {
    d_one <- (log(S_j/K) + (b + (sigma^2) / 2) * T)/(sigma * sqrt(T))
    value <- bs_european_put(S_j, K, r, sigma, T, q) - (1 - exp((b-r)*T) * pnorm(-d_one)) * S_j / q_1
    return(value)
  }

  b_j <- function(S_j, K, r, sigma, T, q = 0) {
    d_one <- (log(S_j/K) + (b + (sigma^2) / 2) * T)/(sigma * sqrt(T))
    value <- -exp((b-r) * T) * pnorm(-d_one) * (1 - 1 / q_1) - (1 + (exp((b-r)* T) * dnorm(-d_one))/(sigma * sqrt(T))) / q_1
    return(value)
  }

  enhance_guess <- function(S_j, K, r, sigma, T, q = 0) {
    cur_bj <- b_j(S_j, K, r, sigma, T, q)
    return((K - RHS(S_j, K, r, sigma, T, q) + cur_bj * S_j)/(1 + cur_bj))
  }

  S_j <- s_star_star_init_value(S, K, r, sigma, T, q = 0)

  guess_limit <- 10000
  iter <- 0

  while(abs(K - S_j - RHS(S_j, K, r, sigma, T, q)) >= 0.0000001) {
    iter <- iter + 1
    residual <- K - S_j - RHS(S_j, K, r, sigma, T, q)
    cur_bj <- b_j(S_j, K, r, sigma, T, q)
    
    #if (iter <= 10 || iter %% 1000 == 0) {
      #cat(sprintf("Iter %d: S_j=%.6f, residual=%.8f, b_j=%.6f\n", iter, S_j, residual, cur_bj))
    #}
    
    S_j <- enhance_guess(S_j, K, r, sigma, T, q)

    guess_limit <- guess_limit - 1
    if(guess_limit <= 0) {
      #cat("Ran out of guesses\n")
      break
    }
  }
  # cat("Converged after", iter, "iterations\n")
  # cat("Final S**:", S_j, "\n\n")

  return(S_j)
}
```

``` {r}
bs_american_put <- function(S, K, r, sigma, T, q = 0) {
  if (T <= 0) {
    return(max(K - S, 0))
  }
  
  S_ss <- tryCatch({
    s_star_star_finder(S, K, r, sigma, T, q)
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(0)
  })
  
  if (is.na(S_ss)) {
    return(bs_european_put(S, K, r, sigma, T, q))
  }

  if(S <= S_ss) {
    return(K - S)
  }

  b <- r - q
  N <- 2 * b / (sigma^2)
  M <- 2 * r / (sigma^2)
  K_other <- 1 - exp(-r * T)
  q_1 <- (-(N - 1) - sqrt((N - 1)^2 + 4 * M / K_other)) / 2

  d_one_ss <- (log(S_ss/K) + (b + (sigma^2) / 2) * T)/(sigma * sqrt(T))

  A_1 <- -(S_ss / q_1) * (1 - exp((b - r) * T) * pnorm(-d_one_ss))

  return(bs_european_put(S, K, r, sigma, T, q) + A_1 * (S / S_ss)^q_1)
}

# Vectorized versions for batch processing
v_bs_american_call <- Vectorize(bs_american_call, vectorize.args = c("S", "K", "r", "sigma", "T", "q"))
v_bs_american_put <- Vectorize(bs_american_put, vectorize.args = c("S", "K", "r", "sigma", "T", "q"))
```

# Monte Carlo

``` {r}
simulations <- 25000
library(future)
library(furrr)
plan(multisession, workers = parallel::detectCores())
```

``` {r}
mc_sim_pathless <- function(S, T, sigma, r, q = 0) {
  n_half <- simulations / 2
  Z <- rnorm(n_half)
  Z <- c(Z, -Z)
  return(S * exp((r - q - sigma^2/2)*T + sigma*sqrt(T)*Z))
}
```

``` {r}
mc_european_call <- function(S, K, T, sigma, r, q = 0) {
  if (T <= 0) {
    return(max(S - K, 0))
  }
  
  paths <- mc_sim_pathless(S, T, sigma, r, q)
  returns <- pmax(paths - K, 0)
  return((sum(returns) / simulations) * exp(-r * T))
}

mc_european_put <- function(S, K, T, sigma, r, q = 0) {
  if (T <= 0) {
    return(max(K - S, 0))
  }
  
  paths <- mc_sim_pathless(S, T, sigma, r, q)
  returns <- pmax(K - paths, 0)
  return((sum(returns) / simulations) * exp(-r * T))
}
```

``` {r}
mc_sim_pathed <- function(S, T, sigma, r, q = 0) {
  steps <- round(T * 52)
  if (steps < 1) {
    return(matrix(S, nrow = simulations, ncol = 1))
  }
  n_half <- simulations / 2
  dt <- 1 / 52

  Z <- matrix(rnorm(n_half * steps), nrow = n_half, ncol = steps)
  Z <- rbind(Z, -Z)
  transformation <- (r - q - sigma^2/2) * dt + sigma * sqrt(dt) * Z
  paths <- matrix(S, nrow = nrow(transformation), ncol = steps)
  paths[, 1] <- S * exp(transformation[, 1])
  if (steps > 1) {
    for (k in 2:steps) {
      paths[, k] <- paths[, k-1] * exp(transformation[, k])
    }
  }
  paths
}
```

``` {r}
mc_american_call <- function(S, K, T, sigma, r, q = 0) {
  steps <- round(T * 52)
  if (steps < 1) {
    return(max(S - K, 0))
  }
  
  paths <- mc_sim_pathed(S, T, sigma, r, q)
  dt <- 1/52

  CF <- pmax(paths[, steps] - K, 0)

  if (steps > 1) {
    for(step in (steps-1):1) {
      x_raw <- paths[, step]
      x <- x_raw / K

      itm_mask <- x_raw > K

      if (sum(itm_mask) < 100) {
        CF <- CF * exp(-r * dt)
        next
      }

      y <- exp(-r * dt) * CF[itm_mask]

      X <- cbind(1, x[itm_mask], 
                 x[itm_mask]^2, 
                 x[itm_mask]^3)
      y_use <- y
      beta <- qr.solve(X, y_use)

      X_all <- cbind(1, x, x^2, x^3)
      continuation <- X_all %*% beta
      continuation <- pmax(continuation, 0)

      exercise <- pmax(x_raw - K, 0)
      exercise_now <- exercise > continuation

      CF[exercise_now] <- exercise[exercise_now]
      CF[!exercise_now] <- exp(-r * dt) * CF[!exercise_now]
    }
  }

  return(mean(CF) * exp(-r * dt))
}
```

``` {r}
mc_american_put <- function(S, K, T, sigma, r, q = 0) {
  steps <- round(T * 52)
  if (steps < 1) {
    return(max(K - S, 0))
  }
  
  paths <- mc_sim_pathed(S, T, sigma, r, q)
  dt <- 1/52

  CF <- pmax(K - paths[, steps], 0)

  if (steps > 1) {
    for(step in (steps-1):1) {
      x_raw <- paths[, step]
      x <- x_raw / K

      itm_mask <- x_raw < K

      if (sum(itm_mask) < 100) {
        CF <- CF * exp(-r * dt)
        next
      }

      y <- exp(-r * dt) * CF[itm_mask]

      X <- cbind(1, x[itm_mask], 
                 x[itm_mask]^2, 
                 x[itm_mask]^3)
      y_use <- y
      beta <- qr.solve(X, y_use)

      X_all <- cbind(1, x, x^2, x^3)
      continuation <- X_all %*% beta
      continuation <- pmax(continuation, 0)

      exercise <- pmax(K - x_raw, 0)
      exercise_now <- exercise > continuation

      CF[exercise_now] <- exercise[exercise_now]
      CF[!exercise_now] <- exp(-r * dt) * CF[!exercise_now]
    }
  }

  return(mean(CF) * exp(-r * dt))
}
```

# Odhady opčních cen

``` {r population}
library(furrr)

# Black-Scholes (vectorized - fast)
t_bs <- system.time({
  usa_call_chains <- usa_call_chains %>%
    mutate(user_bs = v_bs_american_call(S, K, r, sigma, T, q))
  
  usa_put_chains <- usa_put_chains %>%
    mutate(user_bs = v_bs_american_put(S, K, r, sigma, T, q))
  
  euro_call_chains <- euro_call_chains %>%
    mutate(user_bs = bs_european_call(S, K, r, sigma, T, q))
  
  euro_put_chains <- euro_put_chains %>%
    mutate(user_bs = bs_european_put(S, K, r, sigma, T, q))
})

cat("Black-Scholes completed in:", round(t_bs["elapsed"], 2), "seconds\n")

# CRR Binomial Tree (parallelized across options)
t_crr <- system.time({
  usa_call_chains <- usa_call_chains %>%
    mutate(user_crr = future_map_dbl(
      row_number(),
      ~ if (T[.x] <= 0) max(S[.x] - K[.x], 0) else CRRBinomialTreeOption(TypeFlag = "ca", S = S[.x], X = K[.x], Time = T[.x], r = r[.x], b = r[.x] - q[.x], sigma = sigma[.x], n = 100)@price
    ))
  
  usa_put_chains <- usa_put_chains %>%
    mutate(user_crr = future_map_dbl(
      row_number(),
      ~ if (T[.x] <= 0) max(K[.x] - S[.x], 0) else CRRBinomialTreeOption(TypeFlag = "pa", S = S[.x], X = K[.x], Time = T[.x], r = r[.x], b = r[.x] - q[.x], sigma = sigma[.x], n = 100)@price
    ))
  
  euro_call_chains <- euro_call_chains %>%
    mutate(user_crr = future_map_dbl(
      row_number(),
      ~ if (T[.x] <= 0) max(S[.x] - K[.x], 0) else CRRBinomialTreeOption(TypeFlag = "ce", S = S[.x], X = K[.x], Time = T[.x], r = r[.x], b = r[.x] - q[.x], sigma = sigma[.x], n = 100)@price
    ))
  
  euro_put_chains <- euro_put_chains %>%
    mutate(user_crr = future_map_dbl(
      row_number(),
      ~ if (T[.x] <= 0) max(K[.x] - S[.x], 0) else CRRBinomialTreeOption(TypeFlag = "pe", S = S[.x], X = K[.x], Time = T[.x], r = r[.x], b = r[.x] - q[.x], sigma = sigma[.x], n = 100)@price
    ))
})

cat("CRR Binomial Tree completed in:", round(t_crr["elapsed"], 2), "seconds\n")

# Monte Carlo (parallelized across options, 25k simulations)
t_mc <- system.time({
  usa_call_chains <- usa_call_chains %>%
    mutate(user_mc = future_map_dbl(
      row_number(),
      ~ mc_american_call(S[.x], K[.x], T[.x], sigma[.x], r[.x], q[.x]),
      .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
    ))
  
  usa_put_chains <- usa_put_chains %>%
    mutate(user_mc = future_map_dbl(
      row_number(),
      ~ mc_american_put(S[.x], K[.x], T[.x], sigma[.x], r[.x], q[.x]),
      .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
    ))
  
  euro_call_chains <- euro_call_chains %>%
    mutate(user_mc = future_map_dbl(
      row_number(),
      ~ mc_european_call(S[.x], K[.x], T[.x], sigma[.x], r[.x], q[.x]),
      .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
    ))
  
  euro_put_chains <- euro_put_chains %>%
    mutate(user_mc = future_map_dbl(
      row_number(),
      ~ mc_european_put(S[.x], K[.x], T[.x], sigma[.x], r[.x], q[.x]),
      .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
    ))
})

cat("Monte Carlo completed in:", round(t_mc["elapsed"], 2), "seconds\n")
```

```{r timing-summary}
n_call_options <- nrow(usa_call_chains)
n_put_options <- nrow(usa_put_chains)
n_total <- n_call_options + n_put_options

timing_summary <- data.frame(
  Method = c("Black-Scholes (American)", "CRR Binomial (n=100)", "Monte Carlo (25k sims)"),
  Total_Time_s = c(t_bs["elapsed"], t_crr["elapsed"], t_mc["elapsed"]),
  Avg_Time_Per_Option_s = c(
    t_bs["elapsed"] / n_total,
    t_crr["elapsed"] / n_total,
    t_mc["elapsed"] / n_total
  ),
  Options_Per_Second = c(
    n_total / t_bs["elapsed"],
    n_total / t_crr["elapsed"],
    n_total / t_mc["elapsed"]
  )
)

knitr::kable(timing_summary, digits = 4, caption = "Computation Time Comparison")
```

```{r benchmark-100}
    mutate(user_bs = v_bs_american_put(S, K, r, sigma, T, q))
})
cat("  Black-Scholes:", round(t_bs_am_put["elapsed"], 4), "s\n")

t_crr_am_put <- system.time({
  bench_am_put <- bench_am_put %>%
    mutate(user_crr = future_map_dbl(
      row_number(),
      ~ CRRBinomialTreeOption(TypeFlag = "pa", S = S[.x], X = K[.x], Time = T[.x], r = r[.x], b = r[.x], sigma = sigma[.x], n = 100)@price
    ))
})
cat("  CRR Binomial:", round(t_crr_am_put["elapsed"], 4), "s\n")

t_mc_am_put <- system.time({
  bench_am_put <- bench_am_put %>%
    mutate(user_mc = future_map_dbl(
      row_number(),
      ~ mc_american_put(S[.x], K[.x], T[.x], sigma[.x], r[.x], q[.x]),
      .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
    ))
})
cat("  Monte Carlo:", round(t_mc_am_put["elapsed"], 4), "s\n\n")

# European Calls
cat("=== European Call Options (100 options) ===\n")

t_bs_eu_call <- system.time({

    mutate(user_bs = bs_european_call(S, K, r, sigma, T))
})
```

```{r benchmark-100-summary}
  Total_Time_s = c(

    t_bs_eu_put["elapsed"], t_crr_eu_put["elapsed"], t_mc_eu_put["elapsed"]
  ),
  Avg_Time_Per_Option_s = c(

    t_bs_eu_put["elapsed"] / sample_size, t_crr_eu_put["elapsed"] / sample_size, t_mc_eu_put["elapsed"] / sample_size
  ),
  Options_Per_Second = c(
```

```{r validation-plot}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# Reshape to long format for easier plotting
plot_data <- usa_call_chains %>%
  select(option_price, user_bs, user_crr) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(user_bs, user_crr),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "calculated_price"
  )

# Scatter plot with 45-degree reference line
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = option_price, y = calculated_price, color = method)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  facet_wrap(~method) +
  labs(
    x = "Actual Market Price",
    y = "Calculated Price",
    title = "Model Prices vs Market Prices"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r contour-plot}
# Prepare data for contour plot
contour_data <- usa_call_chains %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(moneyness = S / K) %>%
  select(moneyness, T, option_price, user_bs, user_crr) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(user_bs, user_crr),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "calculated_price"
  ) %>%
  mutate(pricing_error = option_price - calculated_price)

# Contour plot: Moneyness (S/K) vs Time to Expiration (T)
# Contours show pricing error (actual - calculated)
#newplot()
ggplot(contour_data, aes(x = moneyness, y = T, z = pricing_error)) +
  geom_contour_filled(aes(fill = after_stat(level)), bins = 20) +
  facet_wrap(~method, nrow = 2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Pricing Error\n(Market - Model)") +
  labs(
    x = "Moneyness (S/K)",
    y = "Time to Expiration (T)",
    title = "Pricing Error Contour Plot - TSLA Call Options",
    subtitle = "Blue = Model overprices, Red = Model underprices"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
#saveplot()
```
